summary: The test aimed to open an existing Incident in the New state and validate the full Incident lifecycle. Execution halted at the login stage due to element interaction failures: the "Show Password" control could not be located within the timeout period, and the "Log in" button matched multiple elements, causing a strict‑mode violation. Consequently, the test could not access the Incident Management module, and the intended incident flow validation was not performed. No application defects were identified; the failures stem from test script locator and synchronization issues. Overall, the test did not meet its objective and is marked as failed.
recommendations: Refine element locators to use unique identifiers (e.g., data‑test‑id) rather than generic text
Implement explicit waits or retry logic for dynamic elements like "Show Password"
Disambiguate the "Log in" button selector by targeting the button role instead of generic text
Review the login page UI to confirm element visibility and accessibility
Update the test script to handle multiple matching elements and enforce robust error handling
